meta.source: City of Cambridge street cleaning tool (Recollect service 762), street shapes from OpenStreetMap
meta.coverage_note: Streets within radius_m of a private point. The point is not stored here; set COVERAGE_CENTER_LAT and COVERAGE_CENTER_LON in .env.

season.text: April 1 to December 31 (no cleaning January to March)

meta.fine: $100 per violation. Cambridge does not tow for street cleaning (it tows for temporary No Parking signs, snow emergencies and unpaid tickets).
caveats: Signs are what get enforced. Check posted signs once.
Valid only while the city keeps these districts and day rules. Re-verify each April.
Odd and even refer to odd and even street numbers; the city tool labels each curb side this way.
Entries with source inferred_from_nearby_addresses were not checked against any address on that street.
Holiday dates for 2027 and 2028 are computed from standard rules and the observed-day convention the city used in 2026 (Saturday to Friday, Sunday to Monday). They are not published by the city yet.

how_to_compute: For each month from April to December, the cleaning date is the nth weekday given by the district rule for that side. No stored dates are needed. If that date is in holidays (date or observed_date), mark the cleaning as a holiday conflict.

street_aliases._note: Keys are normalised spellings (abbreviations expanded) that differ from the street names in this file. Matching ignores case.

holiday_policy.summary: Cleanings that land on a city holiday are moved, not skipped. In 2026 all three conflicts for these districts were moved (Labor Day to the Monday a week earlier, Jul 3 to Tue Jun 30, Indigenous Peoples Day to Tue Sep 29). The new date varies by holiday (3 to 13 days earlier here, and later for some other routes), so it cannot be computed.
holiday_policy.default_behavior: Treat the rule date as unconfirmed. Alert for the rule date anyway, label it holiday_conflict, and look up the actual date from the city calendar when it is published (usually weeks ahead).

city_calendar_lookup.note: Unofficial endpoint behind the city's street cleaning tool. Returns the actual dates including holiday moves. Query one address per district; events named street_sweeping_odd and street_sweeping_even carry the date in the day field.

Blanche Street.note: City tool lists only numbers 4 (no schedule) and 20. Fully inferred.

Brookline Street.note: Even numbers 66 to 172 returned no schedule from the city tool; odd side is C.

Franklin Street.note: Parcels 55 and 150 returned no schedule and were ignored. Ranges listed are checked addresses only.

Massachusetts Avenue.note: Odd and even sides fall in different districts. Even-side N ranges returned no schedule (Central Sq area).

Pacific Street.note: City tool has no numbers below 70. South end inferred as C.
